scope: Only waterfall/mist shaders, waterfall_mist.gd and four authorized contour waterfall functions. Patch only, production files not written by this agent.
roots: External mesh ends at about 7.68 metres while old shader fade spans fixed 5.6–9.2 metres, leaving about 38 percent of tail opacity at mesh boundary before noise.
External terminal mist placement used a 4.4 metre clamped span instead of the same 7.68 metre mesh span, so it sat about 3 metres above the actual foot.
Static periodic geometry folds, periodic cosine normal tilts and full-strength high-frequency flow fields reinforced the comb effect.
Exponential lip offset had an initial diagonal slope. A quarter-ellipse turn gives the existing pond-to-curtain mesh a rounder roll without moving its lip anchors.
design_calls: Retain existing two-layer curtain and material palette, reweight flow toward broad uneven streams and reduce geometric flute depth.
Use otherwise unused external vertex alpha range 0.5–0.99 for normalized lip-to-foot progress. Connected receiving curtains retain 0–0.4 landing metadata.
Terminate external alpha by normalized progress 0.98, allowing Godot vertex color quantization. The original mesh span and water authority remain intact.
Move existing external spray puffs onto the actual tail span and reduce terminal puff diameter. Keep all island-waist cloud puffs byte-for-byte equivalent in source puff data.
Use existing four receiving-water apron puffs as low flattened spray, with modestly stronger local splash opacity.
shader_probe: Both shaders parsed their expected non-sampler uniforms in the headless Godot shader probe. A native Forward+ render remains required.
remaining_visual_checks: Native BASE camera day whole/cliff_close/reverse and night whole. Verify lip roll shape and two-layer transparency at oblique/reverse angles.
Inspect external tail fade against cloud sea, not only isolated geometry. Numeric zero alpha does not establish visual acceptance.
Inspect receiving-water apron in day/night so increased local spray stays compact and does not become a white rug.
headless_environment_note: macOS system certificate collection logs a pre-existing noErr error. Probe process exits 0. Earlier first validation probe counted dummy-renderer MultiMesh readback rather than stored puff data, and was corrected to inspect emitted puff arrays.
